prompt: Vertical 3:4 Musang King Durian themed commercial poster, with a warm cream-white full background, overlaid with low-contrast mustard yellow sunburst patterns, light green leaf silhouettes, and small spiky geometric patterns. On the bottom right, place a whole Musang King durian and one naturally split open; the whole fruit is a plump oval with a yellow-green to olive-green shell covered in dense, thick, orderly conical spikes; the split shell reveals several clear fruit chambers with golden-yellow plump pulp inside, featuring a thick, dense, and smooth texture. The top left uses thick and whimsical hand-drawn fonts to present '猫山王榴莲' (Musang King Durian) with golden-yellow fill, cream-white inner lines, and dark green outer strokes; the subtitle '金黄绵密 浓香细滑' is placed on an olive-green wavy ribbon, with the English 'MUSANG KING DURIAN' in a circular seal format. Add tropical leaves, fruit aroma curves, pulp color blocks, starlight, and small shell icons to the background. High-saturation Q-style vector illustration, layered paper-cut texture, small amount of screen-print grain, background must not be black.

promptZh: 垂直 3:4 猫山王榴莲 主题商业海报，采用 暖奶油白色全背景，叠加低对比度的芥末黄放射状图案、浅绿色叶片剪影以及小型尖刺几何图案。右下角放置一个完整的猫山王榴莲和一个自然裂开的榴莲；完整果实呈饱满的椭圆形，黄绿色至橄榄绿色的外壳上覆盖着密集、粗壮且整齐的圆锥形尖刺；裂开的果壳露出几个清晰的果室，内部是金黄饱满的果肉，呈现出浓厚、绵密且顺滑的质感。左上方使用 粗体且充满趣味的手绘字体 展示“猫山王榴莲”，字体填充金黄色，带有奶油白色内描边和深绿色外描边；副标题“金黄绵密 浓香细滑”置于橄榄绿色的波浪丝带上，并配有圆形印章格式的英文“MUSANG KING DURIAN”。背景添加热带叶片、果香曲线、果肉色块、星光及小型果壳图标。高饱和度 Q 版矢量插画，分层剪纸质感，带有少量丝网印刷颗粒，背景不得为黑色。
